kind: Isolated native CLI cache-continuity experiment, deterministic readers, no native chats
scope: Disposable CLI home, local Git marketplace transport, independent project skill snapshot; never update the real installed plugin or send role messages.
cases: Cache-bound/unknown role: installation deferred without sending a message.
Create independent full skill copy; ordinary-boundary worker actually opens entry and all retained files, records source acceptance.
One actual CLI old-to-new install while two deterministic workers reopen original cache and retained old source.
Retained old source hashes and relative references survive; new source version reads succeed; N2 business result checked.
A corrupted or symlink-dependent retained source is rejected before any upgrade.
stop: Stop on isolation leakage, real-home writes, source-copy/hash failure, unknown target path, command timeout or unexpected concurrent changes; retain failed outputs without relabeling.
